abstract: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor encephalitis is a multistage illness that progresses from psychosis, memory deficits, seizures and language disintegration to a state of unresponsiveness with catatonic features often associated with abnormal movements, and autonomic and breathing instability. While the disorder predominantly affects children and young adults, and occurs with or without tumour association, the presence of a tumour (usually an ovarian teratoma) is dependent on the age, sex and ethnicity.Teratomas present more frequently in women older than 18 years, and are more predominant in black women than Caucasians. Here we present the case of a patient with probable anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. She was subsequently found to have a mature teratoma of the ovary (dermoid cyst). Despite immune-modulated therapy, surgery was eventually performed to remove the cyst. This was met with a good clinical recovery.
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸（NMDA）受容体脳炎は、精神病、記憶障害、けいれん、言語解体から、異常運動、自律神経および呼吸の不安定を伴う緊張病様症状を伴う無反応状態へと進行する多段階の疾患である。本疾患は主に小児および若年成人に生じ、腫瘍の関連の有無にかかわらず発症するが、腫瘍（通常は卵巣奇形腫）の存在は年齢、性別、民族に依存する。奇形腫は18歳を超える女性により多く認められ、白人女性よりも黒人女性に多い。本稿では、抗NMDA受容体脳炎が疑われる患者の症例を提示する。患者は後に成熟奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）を有することが判明した。免疫調節療法にもかかわらず、最終的に嚢腫を除去する手術が行われた。これにより臨床的に良好な回復が得られた。
